metadata.description: Founded in April 2024, Syncwise is a SaaS startup that streamlines project coordination for remote teams. Its platform offers real-time task syncing, cross-tool integrations, and actionable analytics to help businesses optimize collaboration and productivity. With early traction among mid-sized agencies, Syncwise is focused on expanding its feature set and market reach.

roadmap.narrative_description: Syncwise introduces its new Workflow Automation module, enabling users to create custom rules for task assignments and notifications. This release addresses frequent customer requests and opens upselling opportunities.
Syncwise secures its first large enterprise client, a regional consulting firm, marking a significant step toward scaling revenue and validating the product for bigger markets.
The startup hires two customer success managers to improve onboarding and retention. The team begins proactively engaging with clients for feedback and support.

roadmap.milestone_title: Integration with Slack and Microsoft Teams
roadmap.narrative_description: Syncwise launches integrations with Slack and Microsoft Teams, enabling seamless communication between project updates and chat platforms, significantly enhancing user engagement.
Syncwise closes a $1.2M seed round led by a notable VC, providing capital for product development and sales expansion. The team celebrates the milestone and sets new targets for growth.
The company unveils a new analytics dashboard, allowing managers to track productivity trends, bottlenecks, and project progress with actionable insights.
Syncwise is shortlisted for 'Best Collaboration Tool' at a major SaaS industry event, increasing brand visibility and credibility.
Active user accounts surpass 5,000, representing a 100% growth since Q2. The team celebrates the milestone and plans retention campaigns for the new year.
Syncwise releases improved onboarding flows and interactive tutorials, reducing drop-off rates and enhancing the new user experience.
After passing an independent security audit, Syncwise achieves SOC 2 compliance, bolstering trust among enterprise prospects and preparing for larger deals.
Syncwise lands its first international client, a UK-based digital agency, marking the start of global expansion efforts.
The company launches its mobile app for iOS and Android, allowing users to manage tasks and workflows on the go, rounding off the year with an expanded product offering.
